sourceMath: For p, choose horizon L<minimum over opponent generators of max(required gravity prefixes, earliest o owner-turn rank). Take p generators whose every remaining cell latest release U<=L. If a nonnegative hyperedge packing of those generators has weight exceeding o-turn capacity A_o(L), p first-wins by L under all continuations.
